title: New advances in pharmacogenomics.
abstract: In the years to come, pharmacogenomics will make an impact on the development of new drugs. Numerous publications have shown that gene polymorphism can influence drug toxicity and/or efficacy. In order to improve current applications of pharmacogenomics, some technical limitations regarding marker generation, genotyping and biostatistical analysis are being overcome.
mesh_terms: Drug-Related Side Effects and Adverse Reactions
